work-on-location.meta_title: WinProx for cleaning and construction | Work on site

social.og_title: WinProx for cleaning and construction | Work on site
social.og_description: Clock in, work on the customer site and close it out — with QR, GPS work visits and optional CIAO for cleaning. One facility app.

work-on-location.title: Work at the customer site, properly organised.
work-on-location.lead: Cleaning and construction crews work at the customer site, not on one home base. WinProx is the same facility app: clock in at Clock Point, see where to go today, start a GPS work visit, complete tasks and finish. Optional CIAO for cleaning.
work-on-location.flow: Clock in → on site → work → done

video.title: See how WinProx works
video.lead: A worker clocks in via Clock Point, starts the visit at the customer site and completes tasks on a smartphone. No app, no phone chain.

problem.title: Who is where — and is the work done?
problem.lead: Crews move from customer to customer. Without one workflow it is guesswork: has anyone arrived, which tasks are open, was the round finished? WinProx makes that one chain from clock-in to completion.
questions: Has the crew arrived at the customer?
Which tasks or checks are open today?
Who closes an issue on site?
Is presence proven on the site or at the customer?
Can the office see what is done without calling?

steps.title: One workflow at the customer site

items.title: Clock in
items.body: The worker scans the Clock Point QR at the depot or starting point. That opens the shift — clock-in is not proof of the customer location.

items.title: On site
items.body: With GPS work visits the worker starts the visit at the customer location (or a unit with its own pin). That shows the work happens there.

items.title: Work
items.body: Open tasks, inspection rounds and unit checks follow on the smartphone. A problem becomes an issue with a photo, without a separate app.

items.title: Done
items.body: End the visit, clock out. The office sees presence, the roster and completed tasks in one overview.

places.title: For offices, sites and every customer address
places.lead: WinProx ties the work to the place where it happens. The same app in office buildings and on the construction site.
places.close: The worker does not need to hunt for who to call. Clock Point, work visit and task sit in the same flow.

roles.title: One system for crew and office

items.title: For workers
items.body: Clock in, see where to go today, start a work visit and complete tasks on your own phone. No extra app.

items.title: For team leaders
items.body: See who is clocked in, which visits are open and what is still outstanding on the round or site.

items.title: For the office
items.body: Roster, presence and completion in one facility app. Optional CIAO for cleaning; construction follows the same pipeline when the RSZ scope is live.

items.title: For the customer site
items.body: Issues and checks stay tied to the unit or building. No loose notes or WhatsApp chains.

sites.title: Same app, two typical crews
sites.lead: WinProx is not a separate cleaning or construction app. It is Facility plus an optional Time layer, with the same issues, tasks and Clock Point.

items.title: Cleaning
items.body: Crews at several customer addresses: Clock Point, GPS work visit, tasks and unit checks. Optional CIAO filing to the RSZ (request via info@winprox.app).

items.title: Construction
items.body: The same method on site: presence, tasks and issues. CIAO for construction is prepared and goes live with the official RSZ scope — no promise of automatic 100% compliance without that step.

why.title: Why WinProx
items: One facility app: issue → tasks → completion, plus optional Time.
No app for workers: a smartphone and QR are enough.
A GPS work visit proves work at the customer location; clock-in only opens the shift.
The roster is planning; CIAO stays real IN/OUT at Clock Point or the visit.
CIAO for cleaning is available on request; construction follows the same pipeline.
The office follows presence and tasks until they are done.

start.title: Start small. Grow when it works.
start.lead: You do not need to convert every customer or site at once. Start with one crew, one Clock Point or a handful of locations.
start.trial: One month free trial, up to 50 units. No install.

close.title: Ready to try it yourself?
close.lead: Organise work at the customer site: clock in, work on site, close it out. Admins create an account; workers scan and get started.
